items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So there’s a totally different personality between the guy who ran Prestige and the guy who ran Blue Note. And, of course, I was in the middle and I had to keep both of them happy.

ctx.x: And just before that relationship, Billy Taylor came to you and you recorded for Prestige.
Yes, Billy Taylor for Prestige. I’m not sure Billy came through me, I’m not sure, and he might have come through Bob Weinstock, the owner of Prestige Records.
Anyway, I recorded Billy Taylor a number of times, many hours spent in that living room, hearing Billy play.
